## Why Fundraise Up uses performance-based pricing

Our success is directly tied to yours, so we’re invested in helping you raise more. Instead of charging a fixed software subscription, we earn a small share of the donations processed through Fundraise Up. Donor cost coverage helps offset that share, bringing the effective Fundraise Up cost to around 1% on average.

### We’re built to help you raise more

When you raise more, we grow too. So improving your fundraising effectiveness is naturally built into how our model works.

Across thousands of nonprofits, Fundraise Up delivers 3× higher donation conversion than the industry benchmark, ~30% larger average gifts, and ~80% recurring donor retention after one year — backed by 70+ A/B tests every year to keep learning and improving.

Fundraise Up: Our growth depends on helping you grow.

Fixed-cost software: You pay the same subscription whether your fundraising improves or not.

### Keep more of every donation

We make it easy for donors to help cover the costs of giving. Every donation includes payment processing fees (like Stripe’s) plus a small Fundraise Up fee. Our technology transparently drives industry-leading fee coverage, with most donors covering both.

The result: The effective cost that goes to Fundraise Up is typically about 1%, not including processing fees.

Fundraise Up: Fee coverage designed to help more of every donation stay with your mission.

Other models: More costs may fall to the nonprofit or depend on donor tipping.

### We’re invested in your success

Without long-term contracts, every day is a renewal day. That’s why we invest in your success from the start — with white-glove onboarding and migration, dedicated Customer Success, and expert support whenever you need it.

You get the full Fundraise Up platform from day one, while our team keeps working alongside yours to help you get more from it and raise more over time.

Fundraise Up: Full platform and expert partnership from onboarding to ongoing growth.

Traditional software: Long-term contracts, paid services, and higher tiers can make it harder and more expensive to change.

Northwest Harvest uses Fundraise Up’s Salesforce integration to save 624 hours a year in admin tasks. Before Fundraise Up, any change in donor information had to be input manually by their team, which minimized time spent expanding its fundraising campaigns. By improving their staff productivity, it allowed the team to focus on increasing 360 in new recurring plans!

## FAQ

Why is a fee-based strategy advantageous for nonprofits?

Our fee-based approach ensures your nonprofit enjoys flexibility. Your expenses dynamically align with your fundraising success, making this model perfect for both seasonal initiatives and continuous operations. Plus, there are no charges for monthly or annual subscriptions, and no contract is required!

Our nonprofit has chapters, can their account be linked to ours?

Yes, in fact you can share a bank account, have separate bank accounts or a combination of both.

How does your platform distinguish itself from competitors?

Our primary focus is enhancing your conversion rates and boosting your fundraising initiatives. Every feature we offer is backed by data to ensure it drives conversions. Enjoy unlimited access to all features and users, a straightforward flat-rate fee, and readily available customer support.

What methods are available for receiving donations?

We support a wide range of payment options, including credit and debit cards, Google Pay, Apple Pay, cryptocurrencies, iDEAL \| Wero, and direct bank transfers, catering to a global donor base. [Discover all available payment methods](https://fundraiseup.com/platform/payment-methods/).

Are there any restrictions on feature usage within your platform?

No limits at all! Empower your fundraising with our high-conversion checkouts, AI-driven optimizations, a variety of global payment methods, and access to hundreds of innovative features, all designed to unlock your donors’ generosity without any restrictions. [Explore our fundraising features](https://fundraiseup.com/features/).

Is there a limit to the number of users or donors we can have?

We don’t set limits on how many users or donors you can have. Our goal is to help you grow without any barriers.

What type of support can we expect upon signing up?

Comprehensive support is part of the package. Forget about onboarding fees or hourly charges for assistance. Our expert team is here to provide cost-free support, ensuring you have the help you need, when you need it.

What does “~1% effective Fundraise Up cost on average” mean?

Every donation includes third-party processing fees (like Stripe’s) as well as our small fee. Fundraise Up asks donors to cover both, and most of them do. After that coverage, the effective cost that goes to Fundraise Up is typically about 1%, not including processing fees.

Will every nonprofit see an effective Fundraise Up cost of ~1%?

Not necessarily. ~1% is an average benchmark from our data, not a guaranteed rate. The actual amount can vary based on factors like donation size, payment method, fee coverage behavior, and your organization’s pricing.
